searchText: For visibility, please check out this PR here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2115#issuecomment-4709317795 We want to decide on it on tomorrow's ACD so would be great if clients are prepared. one of the problems of introducing *any* queue mechanism for builder deposits was the risk of large builders to gatekeep. doesn't this issue exist with the system contract? the exponential fee makes it very expensive to block the deposit queue, and builders can still buy in for more if they can afford i think a builder can keep the fee prohibitive for others by keeping excess at a certain level yea, but another builder can always pay more to get a spot in the queue, and with a dequeue rate of 256deposits per slot, it won'T even take a long time I see. Deposit processing will happen at a much higher rate than depositing, right? Then probably we don't have such an issue Yeah, the cost for the censoring builder is much higher than four the censored one
